title: Memory grows during a long render
report: Our 8-camera robot rig runs long overnight renders, and renderer memory keeps climbing until the machine runs out of memory. Short renders look fine.
use_case: warehouse robot fleet, overnight long renders

title: Frame spikes every few seconds
report: Previews on our 4-camera drone rig stutter. Average frame time looks normal, but there is a visible hitch every few seconds.

title: Frame time up after a renderer change
report: Since the latest renderer change, our single-camera 4K previews are slower. Nothing else changed in our scenes.

title: Multi-view renders slower after a change
report: Since the latest renderer change, our 12-camera surround-view rig renders much slower than before. Single-camera renders seem unaffected.

title: Renderer crashes on the 12-view setup
report: Jobs on our 12-camera rig fail right at start-up and produce no frames. Smaller rigs still work.

title: Disk fills up during renders
report: Our render machines for the 8-camera rig run out of disk space after a few long jobs, and the jobs get killed.
use_case: warehouse robot fleet, overnight long renders

title: 4K image looks blurry after an upgrade
report: After the engine upgrade, our 4K renders look soft and blurry, especially textures in the distance.

title: Memory alert on the single-view setup
report: A memory alert fired on one of our machines running single-camera renders. We don't know whether the renderer caused it.

title: Stutter report without a capture
report: One of our operators says single-camera renders stutter on their machine. No trace or logs were attached.

title: 12-view jobs fail at start-up (second report)
report: Every 12-camera job dies immediately after launch with no output frames.

title: Stutter and rising memory on the 8-view setup
report: Long renders on our 8-camera rig hitch every few seconds, and machine memory keeps climbing. Two of our teams filed this; nobody knows whether it is one problem or two.
use_case: warehouse robot fleet, overnight long renders

title: Hitching on the 4-view setup, no traces or logs
report: Previews on our 4-camera rig hitch every few seconds. Tracing is disabled on these machines, and their logs were not kept.
difficulty: partial data: no trace, no logs

title: 12-view jobs die, logs lost
report: 12-camera jobs die immediately. The log store for these machines was wiped, so no logs are available.

title: Soft image and slower frames after one upgrade
report: After one upgrade, our 4K renders look blurry and also take longer per frame. The upgrade changed many things at once.
difficulty: two unrelated regressions in one upgrade
